How to play

Place your big ship (5 squares), medium ship (3), and small ship (2) in your waters. Select a ship and click its starting square; use Rotate to switch between right and down. Select a placed ship to move it. You can also shuffle for random placement or clear the fleet to start again. Place all three ships before starting. Click a square in enemy waters to fire; the computer fires back after each shot. A × marks a hit and a dot marks a miss. Sink all three enemy ships to win. Ships can touch, but never overlap.

FIND. FIRE. SINK.
